title: Cork the Whine Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Cork the Whine is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 121 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT B4Prime Central Square Location with Elevated Gulf ViewsWelcome to Cork the Whine, a chic one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath retreat perched on the third floor of the Dreamland Heights building in the very heart of Seaside, Florida’s Central Square. With panoramic views overlooking the Gulf of Mexico and the vibrant town center below, this stylish condo places you steps from Seaside’s iconic shops, restaurants, and beach access—making it an ideal escape for couples or small families seeking a walkable, coastal getaway on 30A.Guests arrive at the Dreamland Heights building and take the elevator to the unit’s entry. Just outside the front door, a shared open-air deck offers seating and sweeping views of both the town and Gulf—an inviting place to pause and soak in the Seaside atmosphere before stepping inside.Light-Filled Living with Private Balcony ViewsThe main living level is accessed via a ship’s ladder and spiral staircase, opening into an airy, loft-style living space with high ceilings and expansive windows that flood the room with natural light. The inviting lounge features slipcovered seating and a queen sleeper sofa, perfect for relaxing after a beach day. Sliding doors lead to a private balcony, where you can enjoy breathtaking views of Central Square activity and the shimmering Gulf beyond—ideal for morning coffee or sunset cocktails.This level also includes a convenient half bath, adding comfort and functionality to the open living space.Kitchen and Dining Designed for Easy Coastal LivingAdjacent to the living area, the fully equipped kitchen is thoughtfully designed for simple meals and casual entertaining. A dining table for two sits just off the kitchen, while the breakfast bar offers seating for three—perfect for quick bites or gathering before heading out to explore Seaside. Everything you need for a relaxed stay is right at your fingertips.King Primary Suite with Town and Gulf ViewsLocated on the first floor, the king primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with large windows showcasing picturesque views of Central Square and glimpses of the Gulf waters below. The bedroom is paired with a full hall bathroom featuring a single vanity and a tub/shower combination—ideal for refreshing after long beach days.Steps from the Beach, Shops, and DiningBeach access is conveniently located at Coleman Pavilion, just a short walk through Central Square. With over 40 shops, restaurants, and cafés directly outside your door, Cork the Whine delivers an unmatched Seaside location where everything is within easy walking distance.Please note that this unit does not include assigned parking. Parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis in shared areas behind the 121 Central Square building and along Quincy Circle.Whether you’re sipping wine on the balcony, enjoying sunset views over the Gulf, or stepping outside into the heart of Seaside’s lively town center, Cork the Whine offers a stylish and unforgettable Seaside, Florida vacation experience.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES700 square feet, located in Dreamland Heights above Seaside Central SquareSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessOverlooks town & ocean with incredible Gulf viewsPrivate balconyPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued; shared permit parking located behind the Holl Building based on availability, with additional permitted parking along Quincy CircleA golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
